channel.title: Aera field notes
channel.description: What consumer wearables can and cannot measure, with the research behind each claim.

item.title: How much sleep do I actually need?
item.description: There is no universal eight-hour rule. Sleep need is personal, and regularity often matters as much as duration.

item.title: Are Apple Watch sleep stages accurate?
item.description: Consumer watch stage charts look precise. Against lab sleep, they are estimates. Duration is the sturdier signal.
